profile.headline: Designing product systems, media pipelines, and AI-assisted workflows with a UX-first approach.
profile.summary: This portfolio has been designed using Figma Make and A.I. tooling. All built from a custom project template designed to cover all facets of QA and development. The template produces agent driven projects that can run autonmously without drift or inefficient compute usage.

operatorProfile.title: Stephen Howe
operatorProfile.description: This section gives an overview of the system operator and his personal quirks.
operatorProfile.notesBody: Work sits at the boundary between design and implementation. The focus is not artefacts, but the systems that generate them — interface logic, motion frameworks, and production pipelines that can scale without losing intent.

files.title: Operator Summary
files.body: Systems-focused designer working across product architecture, media pipelines, and technical prototyping. Builds repeatable frameworks for UI, motion, and AI-assisted production.

files.title: Working Style
files.body: Structured system design with iterative prototyping. Problems are reduced to inputs, constraints, and outputs, then rebuilt into reusable templates, rather than one-off solutions.

files.title: Current Focus
files.body: Media systems, AI-assisted production pipelines, interface architecture, and tools that compress the distance between idea and deployed output.

caseStudies.title: Recent Case Studies
caseStudies.description: Each case exposes the system behind the output: inputs, constraints, pipelines, and repeatable structures.

projects.title: UNCX Video & 3D System
projects.shortDescription: A scalable video and 3D system for product launches, educational content, and corporate announcements.
projects.fullDescription: A production system designed to generate consistent, high-frequency output across video, 3D, and motion graphics using modular assets and reusable tooling.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: UNCX required a repeatable video system capable of supporting launches, explainers, and partner content without rebuilding from scratch.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Production was fragmented: inconsistent style, duplicated effort, and no shared system for assets or timelines.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Built a modular pipeline: reusable 3D scenes, templated compositions, structured timeline blocks, and interchangeable content layers.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Isolated repeatable patterns in camera, lighting, and transitions, then abstracted them into reusable templates.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Delivered as a production system including template libraries, asset structure, and defined motion language.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Reduced production time and enabled consistent, scalable output across campaigns.

projects.title: Badger Club App
projects.shortDescription: Badge tracking platform designed to reduce admin load and unify leader, parent, and child interactions.
projects.fullDescription: A multi-layer product system managing progress tracking, communication, and monetisation across distinct user roles.

overlaySections.title: Brief
overlaySections.body: Build a badge tracking system that reduces admin overhead while supporting multiple user types.

overlaySections.title: Problem Frame
overlaySections.body: Workflows were manual, fragmented, and unclear, placing full burden on leaders.

overlaySections.title: System Design
overlaySections.body: Separated system into operational layers: leader management, parent engagement, and child-facing progress.

overlaySections.title: Prototype Notes
overlaySections.body: Focused on simplifying progress visualisation and reducing cognitive load per role.

overlaySections.title: Delivery
overlaySections.body: Implemented using Supabase backend and React-based frontend with subscription structure.

overlaySections.title: Outcome
overlaySections.body: Reduced admin friction and created a scalable product foundation.
